name: markdown-maker
description: A minimal Markdown editor for macOS

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:renderer" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && npm run dev:main"
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.pack: npm run clean && npm run generate-icon && npm run build && npx electron-builder
scripts.pack:app: npm run clean && npm run generate-icon && npm run build && npx electron-builder --dir && npm run archive
scripts.dist: npm run clean && npm run generate-icon && npm run build && npx electron-builder
